why: Replace visibly regular cluster rows with restrained deterministic placement and scale variation required by the ecology tools.
semantics: Cluster anchors vary by at most .22 cells per axis; sizes vary by at most six percent around the selected base, clamped to native species limits. Existing authored objects remain untouched. Single-cell placement and moves remain exact. No sprites are warped or recolored.
visualObservation: The actual sparse macambira brush result is less rigidly aligned, keeps open ground and coherent small-plant proportions against the existing resident/building references.
browserChecks: density spacing, native validity and deterministic output
trusted sparse brush matches plan with exact atomic undo/redo
bounds, spacing, camp and size rejection
copy and Delete with exact undo
erase tool removes only one object
trusted drag move and Escape cancellation
limits: Only the pictured sparse macambira composition was visually inspected for this change; native checks do not approve every species composition.
The brush remains based on nearby cell candidates; arbitrary organic cluster shapes and mixed habitat/neighbor artwork are not accepted by this evidence.
No new raster artwork, altered automatic generation, or full release acceptance.
